title: Irish Sausage Stir Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful Japanese-inspired stir fry with Irish sausage, perfect for a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add sliced Irish sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add mixed bell peppers and onion, and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add zesty stir-fry sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Stir in cooked Japanese rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
